node: Omnichannel order-management, warehouse-execution, and fulfillment orchestration software
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around retail fulfillment complexity. The cleanest public-market mapping is Manhattan Associates as the reference pure-play for order, warehouse, transportation, store, and omnichannel execution software. The underfollowed lane adds SPS Commerce as a retail trading-partner network, Descartes Systems as logistics/TMS/e-commerce fulfillment infrastructure, and Zebra Technologies as the inventory-accuracy/RFID/mobile-compute hardware layer that enables store and warehouse execution. The main chokepoint is not consumer demand itself, but operational complexity: accurate inventory, real-time fulfillment routing, warehouse/store workflows, trading-partner integrations, carrier connectivity, and implementation friction.
